visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and straight bangs is seen from the waist up, holding a silver flute to her lips in a bright outdoor garden. She is wearing a sleeveless white top with ruffled edges and dark blue pants, smiling gently as her fingers move across the instrument's keys. The background consists of vibrant green foliage and a white wall with stylized, flowing cutouts that allow soft sunlight to filter through. (2) As the performance continues, visual overlays appear, showing semi-transparent, mirrored figures of her playing the flute on either side of the main shot, creating a layered, artistic effect. Close-up shots highlight the intricate movements of her fingers on the silver keys and her focused facial expressions, with a musical staff overlay showing the notes she is playing appearing at the bottom of the frame. (3) The scene shifts between medium shots and tighter close-ups while she maintains a graceful posture, with the sunlight creating a high-key, cheerful atmosphere. The white wall behind her remains a constant architectural element, and her jewelry—a thin bracelet on her left wrist—catches the light as she plays with rhythmic precision.
